It is CONFIRMED only by experiment; the kill-shots above are the verdict, on a 5-20 year horizon (CMB-S4, LiteBIRD, CTA, DESI/Euclid, Hyper-K, ton-scale 0nu-bb). IF confirmed, the payoff is the answers in (T1) -- understanding, not gadgets; practical technology remains long-range (P76, the GR->GPS analogue).
